description.p: ngSid plays SID tunes, the music of the C64: games, demos and the work of generations of composers. The C64 runs in the player, cycle by cycle (6510 processor, VIC-II and CIA), with the reSIDfp emulation of the MOS 6581 and 8580 sound chips, so PSID and RSID tunes with raster tricks, multispeed players and sampled digi sound play as on the real machine.

A card for each of the three voices shows note, frequency, oscilloscope and envelope, next to the digi channel, the filter, a spectrum analyser and level meters. Files and folders can be opened or dropped on the window, and the built-in browser reads the High Voltage SID Collection (HVSC) online.
